Chapter 4:

Auchenorrhyncha in the Agroecosistems of Western Andalusia with focus on the vectors of Xylella fastidiosa: community description, seasonal abundance, and effects of site-specific, climatic and landscape factors

Laura Avivar-Lozano, José Mª. Molina-Rodríguez , Sergio Pérez-Guerrero

2025-10-06

1.3 NDMS and PERMANOVA

tax<-read_excel(here("data/resultado_taxonomia_final2.xlsx")) 
tax1<-tax%>% dplyr::filter(año!=2020, !iden %in% c("noiden", "genero"))

1.3.1 Seleccion por fecha+habitat+crop

species <-dcast(data = tax1, formula = fecha+habitat + crop ~species, fun.aggregate = sum, value.var = "total") 
sum(rowSums(species[-c(1, 2, 3,99)]) == 0) 
## [1] 386
species <- species[rowSums(species[, -c(1,2,3,99)])> 0, ]
sp<-species[,4:98] #Community matriz (Abundance)
sp_crop <- as.factor(species$crop) #metadata crop
sp_habitat <- as.factor(species$habitat) #metadata habitat
sp_full<-species[,2:3] #metadata full
sp_full$habitat <- as.factor(sp_full$habitat) 
sp_full$crop <- as.factor(sp_full$crop)

1.3.1.1 NDMS

 sp1 <- metaMDS(comm = sp,
               distance = "bray",
               trace = TRUE)
## Square root transformation
## Wisconsin double standardization
## Run 0 stress 0.002261958 
## Run 1 stress 0.0009204753 
## ... New best solution
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04378435  max resid 0.5489504 
## Run 2 stress 0.0008566215 
## ... New best solution
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.03680463  max resid 0.4972339 
## Run 3 stress 0.0008067966 
## ... New best solution
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.03969799  max resid 0.3897085 
## Run 4 stress 0.0008810714 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04021408  max resid 0.4847261 
## Run 5 stress 0.001183135 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04445774  max resid 0.6319543 
## Run 6 stress 0.0008329132 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.0427823  max resid 0.4717648 
## Run 7 stress 0.0008355792 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.03512634  max resid 0.4211615 
## Run 8 stress 0.0009531249 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04705439  max resid 0.6298721 
## Run 9 stress 0.0008088436 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04539403  max resid 0.6364746 
## Run 10 stress 0.0008309962 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04516453  max resid 0.5134892 
## Run 11 stress 0.0008818961 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04436026  max resid 0.4617506 
## Run 12 stress 0.001087404 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04672745  max resid 0.4891563 
## Run 13 stress 0.0008576643 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04331634  max resid 0.5178649 
## Run 14 stress 0.000863489 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.0425432  max resid 0.4303735 
## Run 15 stress 0.0007914311 
## ... New best solution
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04540747  max resid 0.4573281 
## Run 16 stress 0.0007490256 
## ... New best solution
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04338519  max resid 0.5180234 
## Run 17 stress 0.0007793287 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04615707  max resid 0.4791502 
## Run 18 stress 0.000879654 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.03721171  max resid 0.3659412 
## Run 19 stress 0.000877616 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.03946492  max resid 0.538835 
## Run 20 stress 0.0008423357 
## ... Procrustes: rmse 0.04289961  max resid 0.5745802 
## *** Best solution was not repeated -- monoMDS stopping criteria:
##      7: no. of iterations >= maxit
##     13: scale factor of the gradient < sfgrmin
# Ajustar especies al NMDS
species_fit <- envfit(sp1, sp, permutations = 999)
species_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(species_fit, "vectors"))
species_scores$species <- rownames(species_scores)  # Asignar nombres de especies
species_scores$r2 <- species_fit$vectors$r
species_scores <- species_scores[species_fit$vectors$pvals < 0.05 & species_scores$r2 > 0.2, ] # Filtrar solo especies con alta significancia

Plot

nmds_points <- as.data.frame(scores(sp1, display = "sites"))
nmds_points$crop <- sp_crop  # add crop
nmds_points$habitat <- sp_habitat   # add habitat
ggplot(data = nmds_points, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = crop, shape = habitat)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +  # Puntos de los sitios
  geom_mark_ellipse(aes(fill = crop), alpha = 0.2) +  # Elipses por cultivo
  geom_segment(data = species_scores, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +  
  geom_text_repel(data = species_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = species),
                  color = "black", size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +  
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15)) +  # Formas: círculo, triángulo, cuadrado
  theme_minimal()

1.3.1.2 PERMANOVA

bray_dist <- vegdist(sp, method = "bray")
permanova<- adonis2(bray_dist ~ crop+habitat, 
                    data = data.frame(sp_full), 
                    permutations = 999, 
                    by = "margin")
print(permanova)
## Permutation test for adonis under reduced model
## Marginal effects of terms
## Permutation: free
## Number of permutations: 999
## 
## adonis2(formula = bray_dist ~ crop + habitat, data = data.frame(sp_full), permutations = 999, by = "margin")
##           Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
## crop       4    6.893 0.03437 3.9035  0.001 ***
## habitat    2    6.240 0.03111 7.0673  0.001 ***
## Residual 425  187.615 0.93556                  
## Total    431  200.537 1.00000                  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
1.3.1.2.1 Dispersion

PERMANOVA asume que la dispersión de los grupos es homogénea

b_c <- betadisper(vegdist(sp, method = "bray"), group = sp_full$crop)
permutest(b_c, permutations = 999)
## 
## Permutation test for homogeneity of multivariate dispersions
## Permutation: free
## Number of permutations: 999
## 
## Response: Distances
##            Df  Sum Sq  Mean Sq      F N.Perm Pr(>F)    
## Groups      4 0.05451 0.013628 6.5775    999  0.001 ***
## Residuals 427 0.88473 0.002072                         
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
boxplot(b_c)

b_h <- betadisper(vegdist(sp, method = "bray"), group = sp_full$habitat)
permutest(b_h, permutations = 999)
## 
## Permutation test for homogeneity of multivariate dispersions
## Permutation: free
## Number of permutations: 999
## 
## Response: Distances
##            Df  Sum Sq   Mean Sq      F N.Perm Pr(>F)   
## Groups      2 0.03555 0.0177760 7.7594    999  0.003 **
## Residuals 429 0.98279 0.0022909                        
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
boxplot(b_h)

No hay diferencias entre la comunidad

1.3.2 Seleccion por habitat+crop

Ordenacion por habitat y cultivo

species<-dcast(data = tax1, formula = habitat + crop ~ code,
               fun.aggregate = sum, value.var = "total")
sum(rowSums(species[, -c(1, 2,98)]) == 0)
## [1] 0
sp<-species[,3:97] #Community matriz (Abundance)
sp_crop <- as.factor(species$crop) #metadata
sp_habitat <- as.factor(species$habitat) #metadata
sp_full<-species[,1:2] #metadata full
sp_full$habitat <- as.factor(sp_full$habitat)
